entries.name: VIP Cascade Priority
entries.body: When a query touches multiple VIP Elements, the cascade resolves priority based on sovereignty gradient.

entries.name: Module Registration
entries.body: New routing modules must be registered with capability declaration before activation.

entries.name: Cascade Determinism
entries.body: Identical inputs must produce identical routing decisions. Non-determinism triggers error mode.

entries.name: Provider Capability Matrix
entries.body: Every AI provider must declare capabilities. Undeclared capabilities are excluded from routing.

entries.name: Graceful Degradation
entries.body: System degrades gracefully under load: VIP cascade first, then core routing, then static fallback.

entries.name: Compute Zone Classification
entries.body: Three compute zones: Standard, Mixed-Compliance, and Contested. Zone determines available providers.

entries.name: Emergency Mode Protocol
entries.body: Low-Power/Emergency mode activates when compute resources fall below threshold. Essential routing only.

entries.name: Federation Protocol
entries.body: Cross-seat communication uses the Federation Bridge. Direct seat-to-seat channels are prohibited.

entries.name: Load Balancing
entries.body: Routing load is distributed across available providers based on capability match, not cost optimization.

entries.name: Query Classification
entries.body: Every query is classified by House, Sphere, and VIP relevance before routing begins.

entries.name: Response Synthesis
entries.body: Multi-source responses are synthesized with conflict resolution and citation requirements.

entries.name: Rate Limiting
entries.body: Per-user and per-application rate limits. Overflow triggers queuing, not rejection.

entries.name: Audit Trail Immutability
entries.body: Audit logs are append-only with cryptographic chaining. No modification after creation.

entries.name: Open-Weight Verification
entries.body: Constitutional compliance must be verifiable using open-weight models without live API access.

entries.name: TransparencyPacket Standard
entries.body: Every routing decision produces a TransparencyPacket with decision trace, provenance, and hash.

entries.name: Error Reporting
entries.body: Routing errors include human-readable explanation and TransparencyPacket reference.

entries.name: Drift Detection
entries.body: Automated drift detection monitors for ontology drift, routing bias, and capability degradation.

entries.name: Performance Metrics
entries.body: Query latency, routing accuracy, and provider availability are continuously monitored.
